why: The manuscript cited evidence living in sibling trees that do not ship with the submission, so a referee could not resolve the citation. These are read-only copies, checksummed against their sources. The sibling trees remain authoritative; if a copy and its source ever disagree, the source governs and the copy must be re-imported.
sources_are_not_git_repositories: The sibling trees use checksums plus PROJECT_MANIFEST.json rather than git, by deliberate design. Their paths are recorded here verbatim.
